name: Microsoft Edge
commands:
reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\EdgeUpdate" /v "UpdateDefault" /f
reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\EdgeUpdate" /v "CreateDesktopShortcutDefault" /f

reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge" /v "BackgroundModeEnabled" /f
reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge" /v "StartupBoostEnabled" /f
reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge" /v "HideFirstRunExperience" /f
reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge" /v "RestoreOnStartup" /f

reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\MicrosoftEdge\Main" /v "AllowPrelaunch" /f
reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\MicrosoftEdge\TabPreloader" /v "AllowTabPreloading" /f

reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\edgeupdate" /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 2 /f
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\edgeupdatem" /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 2 /f
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\MicrosoftEdgeElevationService" /v Start /t REG_DWORD /d 3 /f
reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\lfsvc\Service\Configuration" /v "Status" /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
description: Ensure Edge and related apps work
